title: Worksheet 7: Cyberbullying on Roblox
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Cyberbullying is when someone uses technology, such as chat messages, comments, or in-game actions, to repeatedly hurt, embarrass, or threaten another person. On Roblox, cyberbullying can happen in different ways, including sending mean or threatening messages in chat, excluding a player on purpose during a group game, spreading rumors about a player, or using a game's features to target and harass someone specific. Cyberbullying can feel just as hurtful as bullying that happens in person, and it can sometimes feel even harder to escape, since messages can be sent at any time and may be seen by many other players at once. Experts recommend that a player who experiences cyberbullying should avoid responding in anger, save or take a screenshot of the messages if possible, use the report and block tools built into Roblox, and tell a trusted adult about what happened. Trusted adults can help decide on next steps and make sure the behavior is reported properly.

questions.correct: Using technology to repeatedly hurt, embarrass, or threaten someone

questions.text: Which of the following is listed as an example of cyberbullying on Roblox?
